visualCharacteristics.body: eyebrow (Customer story / Article), title, description, 'Read the story' or 'Read the article' link

usage: Resource/story cards: photo on top, eyebrow (content type), title, description and a "Read the story" link; the whole card is clickable.
reuseGuidance: Use for customer stories and articles. With 3+ text elements, the first is the eyebrow and the second the title (or use a heading for the title).
